collection_scope: Five manually selected original studies; abstract-level review; not comprehensive or a current treatment review
selection_method: Selected during project planning; not imported Open Targets evidence records

records.finding: Certain LRRK2 mutations segregated with inherited parkinsonism in families.
records.supporting_passage: we have found six disease-segregating mutations
records.passage_context: The abstract describes sequencing in 46 families and identifies the gene as LRRK2.
records.source_title: Mutations in LRRK2 cause autosomal-dominant parkinsonism with pleomorphic pathology

limitations.text: This finding concerns particular mutations in families, not all variants or all Parkinson’s cases.

records.review_method: Assistant comparison against original-study abstract; no independent researcher review

records.finding: G2019S was present in 8 of 482 patients in this study of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease.
records.supporting_passage: We assessed 482 patients with the disorder … The mutation was present in eight (1.6%) patients.
records.passage_context: The preceding abstract sentence identifies the investigated substitution as Gly2019 ser (G2019S) and the condition as idiopathic Parkinson’s disease.
records.source_location: Abstract, fourth and fifth sentences; omission marked with ellipsis
records.source_title: A common LRRK2 mutation in idiopathic Parkinson's disease

limitations.text: The observed frequency is specific to this sample; it is not a universal prevalence estimate.

records.review_method: Assistant comparison against original-study abstract; no independent researcher review

records.finding: This study estimated Parkinson’s risk in G2019S carriers at 28% by age 59, 51% by 69, and 74% by 79.
records.supporting_passage: 28% at age 59 years, 51% at 69 years, and 74% at 79 years.
records.passage_context: The full sentence identifies the risk as Parkinson’s disease in a person inheriting the LRRK2 Gly2019Ser mutation.
records.source_title: Phenotype, genotype, and worldwide genetic penetrance of LRRK2-associated Parkinson's disease: a case-control study

limitations.text: These population estimates are not individual predictions or current universal risk estimates.

records.review_method: Assistant comparison against original-study abstract; no independent researcher review

records.finding: Pathogenic LRRK2 variants increased Rab protein phosphorylation in laboratory experiments.
records.supporting_passage: Pathogenic LRRK2 variants mapping to different functional domains increase phosphorylation of Rabs
records.passage_context: Phosphorylation is a chemical modification of proteins. This finding concerns a laboratory mechanism, not clinical benefit.
records.source_location: Abstract, sentence beginning Pathogenic LRRK2 variants
records.source_title: Phosphoproteomics reveals that Parkinson's disease kinase LRRK2 regulates a subset of Rab GTPases

limitations.text: A molecular effect alone does not establish that changing it improves disease outcomes.

records.review_method: Assistant comparison against original-study abstract; no independent researcher review

records.finding: DNL201 inhibited LRRK2 and was well tolerated at doses demonstrating pathway engagement in phase 1 and 1b trials.
records.supporting_passage: DNL201 at single and multiple doses inhibited LRRK2 and was well tolerated at doses demonstrating LRRK2 pathway engagement
records.passage_context: The beginning of this abstract sentence describes phase 1 and phase 1b trials in healthy volunteers and Parkinson’s patients, respectively.
records.source_location: Abstract, sentence beginning In phase 1 and phase 1b
records.source_title: Preclinical and clinical evaluation of the LRRK2 inhibitor DNL201 for Parkinson's disease

limitations.text: Target inhibition and tolerability do not establish slowing of Parkinson’s progression.

records.review_method: Assistant comparison against original-study abstract; no independent researcher review
